setting.culture: A Muslim family in Malaysia; a kampung fishing village near the city - wooden stilt houses with steep tiled roofs, a plank jetty over calm green-blue water, moored wooden fishing boats, coconut palms; sandy shore and worn grey planks underfoot.

data.title: Yusuf Hangs the Wash

premise.hero_want: Yusuf wants to hang the wet wash with no help for the first time.
premise.problem: He has not done it before, and he feels a bit nervous.
premise.mechanism: Yusuf presses ordinary wooden clothes pegs onto a washing line to hold each wet shirt in place.
premise.resolution: Yusuf hangs all the shirts by himself and feels ready to do it again.

key_objects.name: Basket of wet washing

key_objects.name: Washing line and pegs
key_objects.description: A low washing line with simple wooden clothes pegs.

cast.who: Yusuf, a seven-year-old Muslim boy from Malaysia.
cast.appearance: Medium-brown skin, short black hair, teal long-sleeved top, loose tan trousers and brown sandals. His eyes are solid black filled ovals.

cast.who: Yusuf's mum, the only adult in the story.
cast.appearance: Medium-brown skin, mustard-yellow hijab, long navy tunic, loose grey trousers and flat shoes. Her eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: By the sandy shore, Mum has a basket of wet wash. “Can you hang it with no help?” she said.
pages.scene: Outside one wooden stilt house in the kampung fishing village. Mum holds the basket beside a low washing line. Yusuf looks at the wash. Calm green-blue water, a plank jetty, moored wooden fishing boats, steep tiled roofs and coconut palms sit in the background. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Yusuf has not hung the wash before. His hands feel cold.
pages.scene: Yusuf stands close to the line with his hands held together. Mum waits calmly beside him. The basket and empty line remain in place. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Mum clips one shirt on the line. “Press the peg hard,” she said.
pages.scene: Mum clips the yellow shirt to the line with two wooden pegs as Yusuf watches closely. Three shirts remain in the basket. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Mum went in. Yusuf gets a wet shirt from the basket.
pages.scene: Mum is now inside and out of sight. Yusuf stands alone by the line and lifts the red shirt from the basket. The yellow shirt hangs on the line. Yusuf's eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: He clips it on the line. It stays up.
pages.scene: Yusuf presses a wooden peg onto the red shirt. The red and yellow shirts hang firmly on the line. His eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Yusuf smiles and clips up more shirts.
pages.scene: Yusuf clips the last blue shirt to the line. The yellow, red and green shirts already hang beside it. The basket is empty. His eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Soon, all the wash hangs on the line. Yusuf is glad he did it with no help.
pages.scene: Yusuf stands proudly beside all four shirts on the line. The empty basket rests nearby. Boats float on the calm water behind him. His eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Mum came out, and Yusuf said, “I did it! I can hang the wash next time!”
pages.scene: Mum returns and smiles at Yusuf and the neat row of shirts. Yusuf points proudly to the washing line. The same stilt house, jetty, boats, sandy shore and coconut palms remain behind them. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

Show the basket of wet shirts, sandy shore, worn grey planks, calm green-blue water, a plank jetty, moored wooden fishing boats, steep tiled roofs and coconut palms. data.cold_read: A warm, clear first-time-alone story with one task, one adult, two key objects and one familiar mechanism. Yusuf completes most of the washing and directly causes the successful ending. The main fault is a contradiction about whether he had help; the revised story makes Mum demonstrate with one shirt and Yusuf hang the rest alone.

issues.detail: Mum asks Yusuf to hang the wash “with no help”, but then clips up one shirt herself. Yusuf later says he completed the task with no help. The revision makes Mum demonstrate with one shirt and asks Yusuf to hang the rest.
“His hands feel cold” is a stiff, indirect way to show nerves. The revision simply says that Yusuf feels a bit scared.
The original opening reads slightly like a picture caption. The revision gives Mum a simple action—setting down the basket—while keeping the location clear.
